Workspace-specific instructions for the Angular project scaffold.
- TypeScript configured for Angular development
- Angular CLI scaffolding in progress
- Standard build and serve configuration

The application is a responsive web application built with Angular. It follows the Angular style guide and best practices for component-based architecture, modularity, and maintainability.

Every modification to the Angular project should follow the Angular style guide and best practices. Ensure that all components, services, and modules are properly structured and named according to Angular conventions.

When adding new features or making changes, please ensure that:
- All new components, services, and modules are generated using the Angular CLI to maintain consistency.
-Compilation errors are resolved before committing changes.
